purpose: Shared operational defaults and handoff state; not proof of implementation or live AWS health.

implementation_contract.secrets: Never share or commit AWS credentials; local mode must not contact AWS.

cloud.missing_values_action: Continue local-mode work. Prepare exact configuration/validation request in the relevant Issue; operator executes on next authorized window.

automation_limits: Private-repo invitation must be accepted by each member.
Member must authenticate their own GitHub and use an AI with local terminal/GitHub tools.
Commands run when the member or their AI executes them; no unattended backend is active.
Only authorized operator changes AWS; missing cloud parameters are never guessed.
Human review and genuine evidence remain required.
